hints: Apply the binomial expansion $\binom{5}{r}3^{5-r}(-2x)^r$ to find the first three terms of $(3 - 2x)^5$.
walkthrough:
Expand $(3 - 2x)^5$ in ascending powers of $x$ up to $x^2$ using the binomial theorem:
$$(3 - 2x)^5 = \binom{5}{0}3^5 + \binom{5}{1}3^4(-2x) + \binom{5}{2}3^3(-2x)^2 + \dots$$

hints: Multiply relevant terms with $(243 - 810x + 1080x^2)$ that produce $x^2$ powers: $16(1080) + 8(-810) + 1(243)$.
walkthrough:
Expand the quadratic factor $(4 + x)^2$:
$$(4 + x)^2 = 16 + 8x + x^2$$

Identify all cross-product pairs with $(243 - 810x + 1080x^2)$ that generate $x^2$ terms:
$$\text{Terms in } x^2 = [16 \times 1080x^2] + [8x \times (-810x)] + [x^2 \times 243]$$

Sum the individual coefficients:
$$\text{Coefficient of } x^2 = 16(1080) + 8(-810) + 243 = 17280 - 6480 + 243 = 11043$$
